classification: OPENING_CONSUMED — RUN FAILED AFTER SUCCESSFUL SEALED READS — NO RESTART ATTEMPTED

sealed_reads.consumption_trigger: the first successful pinned validation GetObject — both the frozen state machine and the owner's rule now agree the opening is SPENT

failure.cause: the output directory /opt/mr002/out/valoos/validation did not exist. No component creates the output tree: assert_root_vacant checks vacancy and the publisher opens with O_CREAT|O_EXCL, but nothing calls makedirs.
failure.outputs_produced: none — the output tree is empty

masking_defect.finding: the ORIGINAL failure reason is LOST
masking_defect.mechanism: runner.run calls _publish_run from its `finally` block; when publication raised, that exception propagated and replaced whatever exception had set outcome.disposition
masking_defect.consequence: we know publication failed and that all 8 reads succeeded, but not what the run itself did between the reads and the finally block
masking_defect.severity: independent of the directory bug and arguably worse: it destroys the diagnosis of any post-read failure

timing_observation.note: the whole run took 4 seconds and read 16.6 MB. Production over 850 sessions could not have completed in the remaining time, so an exception almost certainly occurred shortly after decoding. Its identity is unknown because of the masking defect above.
timing_observation.explicitly_not_asserted: no claim is made about which step failed

preserved_evidence: SSM command id and invocation record (status, response code, start/end)
CloudTrail AssumeRole event with reader session identity
CloudTrail S3 data events for all 8 reads with keys, VersionIds and byte counts
IAM latch state before, during and after
boundary: No restart. No second opening. No OOS access. No reader re-assumption after the failure. Stopped for adjudication.
